items.title: Med-HEAL: Analyzing and Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical LLMs with Hallucination-Aware In-Context Learning
items.title_zh: Med-HEAL：利用幻觉感知上下文学习分析与缓解医疗 LLM 幻觉
items.summary: Med-HEAL builds a hallucination dataset by evaluating BioMistral-7B on open-ended clinical question answering from EHRNoteQA, with outputs labeled by a GPT-4o LLM-as-a-judge pipeline plus human auditing by medical student reviewers. Across five open-source LLMs, a self-critique pipeline improved accuracy for three of five models without parameter updates.

items.title: ClawHub Security Signals: When VirusTotal, Static Analysis, and SkillSpector Disagree
items.title_zh: ClawHub 安全信号：当 VirusTotal、静态分析与 SkillSpector 判断不一致
items.summary: ClawHub Security Signals is a sanitized dataset of 67,453 latest public OpenClaw skill versions pairing redacted SKILL.md content with registry verdicts and evidence from VirusTotal, static heuristic analysis and NVIDIA SkillSpector. Rather than estimating prevalence, it studies scanner disagreement: any pair of scanners overlaps on at most 10.4% of combined positives, only 0.69% of skills are flagged by all three, and 81.9% of flagged skills are identified by a single scanner.

items.title: Reliable Post-Retrieval Assembly for Agent Memory: Separating Evidence Extraction from Policy Execution
items.title_zh: 面向智能体记忆的可靠检索后组装：将证据抽取与策略执行分离
items.summary: The paper studies post-retrieval assembly failures, where a memory system retrieves relevant evidence but answer generation entangles semantic filtering, conflict resolution, prior suppression and output generation. On MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation at 262K tokens, separating evidence extraction from policy execution reaches 82%/93% single-hop and 27%/41% multi-hop with gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o, versus a best reported 54% single-hop in the benchmark comparison and at most 7% multi-hop across the 22 reported systems.

items.title: ClaudioDrews/memory-os
items.title_zh: ClaudioDrews/memory-os：为 Hermes Agent 打造的七层记忆操作系统
items.summary: ClaudioDrews/memory-os is a Python seven-layer memory operating system for Hermes Agent, with persistent memory in Qdrant, structured facts, fabric recall, an auto-curated wiki and surgical context injection. It runs locally with any LLM provider and had 1,381 GitHub stars.

items.title: Bridging Requirements and Architecture: Multi-Agent Orchestration with External Knowledge and Hierarchical Memory
items.title_zh: 连接需求与架构：融合外部知识与分层记忆的多智能体编排
items.summary: MAAD is a knowledge-driven framework that orchestrates Analyst, Modeler, Designer and Evaluator agents to transform requirements specifications into multi-view architectural blueprints with quality attribute assessments. It injects architectural standards and patterns via RAG, uses a hierarchical memory of design history for iterative refinement, and is reported to produce more complete, modular and traceable architectures than MetaGPT across 10 case studies.

items.title: LongAttnComp: Cross-Family Context Compression for Long-Context Reasoning
items.title_zh: LongAttnComp：面向长上下文推理的跨模型族上下文压缩
items.summary: LongAttnComp adapts AttnComp by fine-tuning a lightweight cross-attention scoring layer and adding token-level chunking, a token-budget top-p algorithm, positional reordering and a format-agnostic query parser. With a two-stage fine-tuning recipe, it matches or exceeds full-context accuracy on InfiniteBench Code-Debug and transfers across four target models from three families.

items.title: RUC-NLPIR/Arbor
items.summary: Arbor is a Python generalist autonomous research agent from RUC-NLPIR that runs experiments, conducts research and iteratively optimizes its work without human intervention. It had 1,127 GitHub stars and 128 forks.

items.title: PentesterFlow/agent
items.title_zh: PentesterFlow/agent：终端里的智能体化攻击性安全工具
items.summary: PentesterFlow/agent is a TypeScript tool that brings agentic offensive security into the terminal, aimed at penetration testing, bug-bounty hunting and automated security auditing. It had 1,419 GitHub stars and 258 forks.

items.title: AhmadHassan-BTed/Noria
items.title_zh: AhmadHassan-BTed/Noria：面向即时通讯平台的智能体抽取器
items.summary: Noria is a JavaScript agentic extractor that receives messages and URLs through chat, scrapes web data to score content against custom matrices such as jobs or scholarships, and returns a structured summary with a match score. It had 3,076 GitHub stars.
